programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.a_level_offer: A*AA including A* in Mathematics, and a minimum of one science subject from Computer Science, Further Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry or Physics
programs.ib_offer: 37 points overall with 7, 6, 6 at Higher Level, including 7 in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches; at least one science subject (Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry or Biology) at Higher Level
programs.ap_offer: US High School Graduation Diploma with an overall GPA of 3.3, grade 5 in AP Calculus BC or Calculus AB (subscore not accepted), grade 5 in AP Physics or Computer Science, and grades 5 and 4 in two further AP tests. Alternative: same GPA and the Calculus and Physics/Computer Science 5s achieved in grade 11, plus grade A in AP classes in two further academic subjects from the fall semester of Year 12. English: grade B in Grade 11 English (if years 10-12 were in the USA) or grade 4 in AP English Language and Composition.
programs.required_subjects: A level Mathematics (with a significant pure element) at A* plus one science (Computer Science, Further Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry or Physics); IB HL Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches at 7 (other Maths courses not accepted for this programme)
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT (0-120 scale) 90 overall with no subskill below 22. TOEFL iBT (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall with at least 4.5 in all subskills.
programs.english_note: Course minimum: GCSE/IGCSE English Language grade C/4 (English Literature not accepted), or IELTS 6.5 overall with no subskill below 6.5, or the TOEFL scores above, or an acceptable equivalent. English tests are valid for two years.
programs.notes: 2027 entry page. Contextual offer AAA including Mathematics and a science. GCSE/IGCSE: five GCSEs including Mathematics grade B/6 and English Language grade C/4; the page also says grade 8 is required for IGCSE English as a Second Language. International fee for September 2027 entry is stated on the page. The AP route comes from the Department of Computer Science country page, which states it is for September 2026 entry and subject to annual review: https://www.cs.manchester.ac.uk/study/international-students/country-specific-information/ . Applicants may hold an offer for only one course in the Department.

programs.name: Economics BSc
programs.a_level_offer: AAA, including Mathematics (preference given to applicants studying two subjects from the School's list of economics-related subjects)
programs.ib_offer: 36 points overall with 6, 6, 6 at Higher Level including Mathematics
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.0, including grade B in English Language and Mathematics, and 5, 5, 5 in three AP tests; for BSc Economics a 5 in AP Calculus BC is required. (School of Social Sciences guide for the AAA level.)
programs.required_subjects: A level Mathematics; IB Higher Level Mathematics; AP Calculus BC at 5 for US applicants; GCSE/IGCSE English Language grade C/4 and Mathematics grade B/6
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT (0-120 scale) 90 overall with a minimum of 20 in each subset. The Economics page gives no 1-6 scale figure (Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering pages list 4.5 overall with 4.5 in each subskill).
programs.english_note: Course minimum: GCSE/IGCSE English Language grade C, or IELTS 6.5 overall with no lower than 6 in any component (in-person IELTS at official test centres only), or TOEFL iBT 90 overall with at least 20 in each subset, or IGCSE English as a Second Language grade B, or an acceptable equivalent.
programs.notes: 2027 entry page. The page lists the course as 3 or 4 years (UCAS L102); 3 years is shown. Contextual offer ABB including A in Mathematics. Manchester does not interview. International fee for September 2027 entry is stated on the page. The AP route comes from the School of Social Sciences Americas page, which calls its entries a guide only: https://www.socialsciences.manchester.ac.uk/study/international-students/country-specific-information/americas/ .

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng
programs.a_level_offer: A*A*A in Mathematics, Physics and one other subject (Further Mathematics may be considered in place of Physics, case by case)
programs.ib_offer: 38 points overall with 7, 7, 6 at Higher Level, including Mathematics and Physics
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma with a GPA of 3.2 or above and Advanced Placement examinations at 5, 5, 5, which must include Calculus BC, Physics (Physics 2 or Physics C Mechanics) and one other AP subject (excluding Calculus AB and Physics 1). A High School Diploma on its own is not enough: applicants need a suitable recognised Foundation Year.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics and Physics (A level; IB Higher Level, either Mathematics course accepted); AP Calculus BC and AP Physics 2 or Physics C Mechanics for US applicants
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT (0-120 scale) 90 with no subskill below 22. TOEFL iBT (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall and 4.5 in all subskills.
programs.english_note: Course minimum: GCSE/IGCSE English Language grade 4/C, or IGCSE English as a Second Language grade 8, or IELTS 6.5 overall with no subskill below 6.5, or the TOEFL scores above, or Pearson PTE 70 overall with no subskill below 70, or an acceptable equivalent. English tests are valid for two years.
programs.notes: 2027 entry page for the 3-year BEng (H300). Contextual offer A*AA in Mathematics, Physics and one other subject. GCSEs: five at grade A*/8 to B/6 including Mathematics and a science, English Language grade C/4. If you take four or more A levels, the offer is made on the best-suited subjects. Manchester does not hold interviews. International fee for September 2027 entry is stated on the page. The AP route comes from the Faculty of Science and Engineering country page: https://www.se.manchester.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/mechanical-engineering/country-entry-requirements/ .
